</ The thesis

Design is not ornamentdecorationtastepolish.
It is the shortest path between
your product and a yes.

When every section answers the right question at the right time, people do not have to work to understand. They just decide.

The people who went through it tell it better than I do.

</ Who does it

For 7 years I have helped clinicsspecialistscourse creatorscompanies bring to the web the same quality they already deliver in person.

I started in graphic design and moved to the web when I noticed something simple: most good businesses have a site that does not tell their story properly. It is not a lack of care, it is a lack of structure. The information is there, just in the wrong order.

That is what became my work. Before opening Figma, I work out who buys from you, what that person needs to know and when. Design comes after, to make that path beautiful and easy to follow.

And I like working close. You talk to me from start to finish, with no middleman, and I explain the reason behind every choice, because a good site is one you understand, defend and are proud to send to someone.

Nice to meet you, I am Gustavo.
Graphic designer and web designer.

Common ⁞ questions

+

No fine print. Here is everything you need to know about how I work, deadlines and delivery before we start.

Who works on my project?

Me, from start to finish. You always talk to the same person, from the first call to the published site. That is why I take on few projects at a time: it is how each one gets real attention.

How long does it take?

It depends on the scope. After the briefing we set a clear schedule, and I work to deliver quality within the agreed deadline. Along the way I show you the progress, so you follow every step with me.

What does it cost?

It depends on the size and the scope, since every site is made to measure. Tell me what you need through the form and I come back with a detailed proposal: what is included, the timeline and the price, all in writing.

What if I do not like the layout?

Every project already includes revision rounds, so there is room for that. And since the page structure is approved before the design starts, what usually changes are style details. If something is not right for you, just tell me and we work it out together until it is the way you want.

What kind of business do you work with?

I have worked with clinics, doctors, course creators, e-commerce and service companies. Every field has its own vocabulary, and learning yours is part of the process. If you like, send me your industry and I will tell you what tends to work there.

Do you build it too, or only deliver the design?

I build it too. Beyond the design, I code it, publish it and leave the site live and working. You do not need to find a developer afterwards or explain the layout to someone else. What we agree at the start is what runs on your domain at the end.

And after the site goes live?

You get 30 days of tweaks included, to fine-tune whatever comes up in everyday use. After that, if it makes sense, we can arrange ongoing support so the site keeps evolving. The files and the domain are yours from day one, and the support is always optional.
